title: Derivative under a coordinate change
statement: Let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, let $i,j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be distinct, and let $c\in\mathbb{F}_2$. The derivative bit at coordinate $j$, formed by summing all coordinates of its input other than $j$, changes by adding $c$ when $c$ is added to coordinate $i$ of $x$.
